items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He got Clark Terry and Booker Ervin. I can’t remember who else. But the album is there, Joe Williams at Newport.

ctx.x: Joe, I felt, is the greatest male singer of all time, after Louis Armstrong. I always have to put Louis first, because he’s in a class by himself. He’s the daddy, like Billie Holiday. “I’m as close as I can get to Louis Armstrong,” she would say. Joe was the absolute professional all the way. It was a delight to record him. We recorded him in two contexts at RCA. One was studio dates, with Jimmy Jones, his favorite arranger. Those sessions went off beautifully, because everything was totally professional. We…
